summary: With `HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR` in `REMOTE_HOST_HEADERS`, controller trusts `X-Forwarded-For`, which can be faked if controller is reachable without the load balancer or the proxy doesn't validate it. Set Proxy IP Allowed List in Settings > Automation Execution > System; requests from hosts not on the list are rejected.
questions: Is X-Forwarded-For in REMOTE_HOST_HEADERS a security risk?
What is the Proxy IP Allowed List?
Requests rejected after setting known proxies in controller
